_comment: Ground truth for external/psxport/tools/producer_class.py selftest. A discriminator run against ONE class is not known to discriminate, so BOTH lists must stay non-empty (the tool exits 2 = INAPPLICABLE otherwise). Every entry cites why it is ground truth.

_projecting_why.8002BC9C: the four-copy radial plume. Ported natively as Render::radialPlumeRender (game/render/fx_plume.cpp), which composes the object transform through projComposeObjectHost — i.e. it demonstrably projects.
_projecting_why.8003B320: QuadRtptSubmit::submitQuad, already native. The name is the evidence: it runs RTPT.

_flat2d_why.8004FFB4: Panel::fillQuad (game/ui/panel_fill.cpp), the codebase's exemplar REBUILT 2D producer: a screen-space panel fill with a decoded packet layout and no projection of any kind.
